coverage_decisions.decision: PMT offers this general Practical Skills PDF rather than a separate summary for each required chemistry practical in this index. Reviewed it alongside the existing full eight practical methods, AQA practical requirements and SR application pages. Preserved every apparatus diagram. Added pilot choices, two-reading uncertainty, cooling extrapolation and method-specific improvements. Did not copy unqualified discard-anomaly advice or insist every experiment has a control group.
